_metadata.description: Ticket classification dataset for testing AI triage accuracy
_metadata.usage: Used to validate ticket triage accuracy (target: >90%)

tickets.subject: Password reset
tickets.description: I forgot my password and can't log in.

tickets.subject: Account locked
tickets.description: My account got locked after too many failed login attempts. Please unlock it.

tickets.subject: Cannot access email
tickets.description: Outlook keeps saying my credentials are invalid even though I just changed my password.

tickets.subject: New employee setup
tickets.description: We have a new hire starting Monday. Need to create their AD account, assign licenses, set up email, and provision laptop.

tickets.subject: Production server down
tickets.description: Our main production web server SRV-PROD-01 is completely unresponsive. All customers are affected. This is critical.

tickets.subject: Slow network performance
tickets.description: Internet is extremely slow on the 3rd floor. Affecting about 20 users.
